basic_info.description: Experience the perfect blend of historic charm and modern luxury at this beautiful Edwardian home in San Francisco's coveted Lone Mountain neighborhood. This spacious 3BD, 3BA Condominium features an open floor-plan, a modern gourmet kitchen featuring a central island, in-unit washer/dryer, storage, and 1-car parking. The serene primary suite offers an en-suite bath with travertine tile, marble vanities, and premium fixtures, while the versatile detached studio with a kitchen and bath, provides the ideal space for guests, a home office, or creative pursuits. Located just blocks from Golden Gate Park and the Presidio, this home offers unmatched access to San Francisco's best outdoor spaces, cultural attractions, and charming neighborhood spots. Enjoy nearby playgrounds, local cafes, and the community-focused atmosphere of Lone Mountain and Inner Richmond, where tree-lined streets, top-rated schools, and excellent walkability create a true urban retreat. Complete with 1-car parking, shared garden space, storage, and thoughtful energy-efficient touches, this residence is a rare opportunity to own a timeless piece of San Francisco in a location that perfectly balances vibrancy, convenience, and tranquility.
